title: PF1 Critical Effects
description: A critical hit and fumble effect system for Pathfinder 1e: a self-contained effect catalog, a fumble resolution flow, and PF1 conditions and buffs attached to effects as mechanical outcomes.

requires.reason: Used to wrap PF1's crit-damage pass so critical damage can be deferred until a critical effect has been chosen, without conflicting with other modules that wrap the same methods.
Every die the players roll during a fumble or critical resolution is posted as a roll request, including the player-visible result table.

recommends.reason: Optional integration: a great many critical and fumble effects inflict ongoing bleed, which this module turns into automated per-round damage instead of prose to track by hand. Its optional Deep Bleed rule also routes that bleed through dedicated healing.
Optional integration: individual effects may use its buff automation to offer an apply-buff button. The engine is fully functional without it.

Optional integration: supplies the designation for creatures immune to critical hits, which marks the Critical Effect button on attack cards and banners the resolution dialog. PF1 models critical immunity nowhere natively. Without it, no creature reads as immune and nothing else changes.
